findings.message:
Phishable.withdrawAll(address) (../sb/phishable.sol#18-22) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- _recipient.transfer(this.balance) (../sb/phishable.sol#21)
findings.name: arbitrary-send-eth

findings.message: Phishable.withdrawAll(address) (../sb/phishable.sol#18-22) uses tx.origin for authorization: require(bool)(tx.origin == owner) (../sb/phishable.sol#20)
findings.name: tx-origin

findings.message:
Phishable.constructor(address)._owner (../sb/phishable.sol#12) lacks a zero-check on :
		- owner = _owner (../sb/phishable.sol#13)
findings.name: missing-zero-check

findings.message: solc-0.4.26 is an outdated solc version. Use a more recent version (at least 0.8.0), if possible.
findings.name: solc-version

	- TupleAssignmentMultiStackSlotComponents
	- MemoryArrayCreationOverflow

	- SignedArrayStorageCopy
	- ABIEncoderV2StorageArrayWithMultiSlotElement
	- DynamicConstructorArgumentsClippedABIV2
	- UninitializedFunctionPointerInConstructor_0.4.x
	- IncorrectEventSignatureInLibraries_0.4.x
	- ABIEncoderV2PackedStorage_0.4.x
	- ExpExponentCleanup
	- EventStructWrongData

It is used by:
